name: Explicit integer Conv accumulation with fixed floating boundary v1
scope: Eight already-used calibration training vectors, seed26 fixed graph. Numerical diagnostic only; no accuracy, training, validation, test or FPGA claim.
preserved_baseline: Original QDQ + FP32 Conv; restore same52foldedConvweights/qparams and reproduce old7of8pass and failingindex3 before changing arithmetic.
candidate_change: New numerical reference candidate, not a claim that old standardQDQ has been fixed.

arithmetic.activation_quantisation: FP32 division by stored scale, nearest-even round, addUINT8zero-point and saturate0..255
arithmetic.weight: Use exact existing52packedINT8arrays, encode asUINT8(w+128) withzero-point128 for ConvInteger kernel compatibility; no new calibration or weight quantisation
arithmetic.accumulation: Subtract zero-points and exact INT64 reference dot products, assert worst-case absolute sum bound fits signedINT32; exported standardConvInteger returnsINT32
arithmetic.reconstruction: CastINT32toDOUBLE, multiply input scaleDOUBLE then per-output-channel weight scaleDOUBLE, add originalFP32bias castDOUBLE, castresultFP32
arithmetic.non_conv_operations: OriginalFP32Torch/ONNX operations retained; not an all-integer network or fixed-point hardware design

decisions: Report everyvector and preserve failures; no formalQAT until same gate and actual-gradient smoke pass on every trainingseed under a separately approved/frozen numerical implementation.
